requirement: Root creates only a NEW EMPTY registration_namespace directory. Bootstrap input, reviewed producer, tools and all input refs reside outside that parent. First stage validates entire emptiness before selecting fresh children, and rechecks complete emptiness immediately before leaf creation. Any old manifest, file, hidden entry, symlink or unrelated child makes it nonempty and is refused; inspection errors propagate. No removal/cleanup/retry is added.
unchanged: registration_layout remains unchanged and does not require emptiness. Subsequent draft/native can use the stage-containing parent under existing exact layout, reviews, refs, alias/fresh-child and native authority guards.
